mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 104.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, reducing equity risk appetite and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both CPIAUCSL > 295.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 680 billion dollars signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and prompts the Fed to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 680000.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to a hawkish monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k in 3 months and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the specified direction, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 19800 billion dollars signals strong economic growth, which increases corporate earnings and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a low-inflation environment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 19800.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
